summaries.zh: 通过共振激发和自发衰变，在光镊中俘获的单铯原子实现了原子-光子纠缠，原始保真度为0.
summaries.ja: 光ピンセットに捕捉された単一セシウム原子において、共鳴励起と自然崩壊により原子-光子もつれを実証し、生の忠実度0.

title: Contrast enhanced imaging through weakly scattering media with spatially entangled photons
abstract: Improving the image contrast of objects immersed in weakly scattering media can be achieved using various strategies. One common approach is to reject events associated with scattered photons in favor of the detection of ballistic photons. While this is traditionally done via time gating or spatial filtering, we propose a different approach based on probing the object with spatio-temporally entangled photon pairs. We show that coincidence detection, followed by post-selection on spatially correlated events, allows us to isolate ballistic from scattered bi-photons, thereby enhancing image contrast relative to a single-photon detection strategy, and simultaneously removes events due to background light. Our predictions are obtained via numerical simulations and confirmed by experiments conducted in two configurations where either both photons or only one illuminates the scene. In both scenarios, correlation post-selection shows an improvement in image contrast at the expense of higher shot noise due to the lower number of events. The latter can be partially compensated for by appropriately combining events from several post-selection windows. Our findings will enable extending imaging through scattering media into the quantum imaging framework in settings where adaptive optics, time gating, and spatial filtering are impractical.

summaries.en: Utilizing spatially entangled photon pairs with coincidence detection and correlation post-selection enhances image contrast in weakly scattering media by isolating ballistic from scattered photons, despite increased shot noise.
summaries.zh: 利用空间纠缠光子对进行符合探测和相关性后选择，通过分离弹道光子与散射光子，增强了弱散射介质中的图像对比度，尽管会引入更高的散粒噪声。
summaries.ja: 空間的に絡み合った光子対を用いた同時検出と相関後選択により、弱散乱媒体中の画像コントラストを向上させるが、散乱光子から弾道光子を分離する一方で、ショットノイズが増加する。

title: A hidden bottleneck in classical and quantum linear reservoir computing
abstract: We identify a hidden bottleneck in the information processing capacity of linear reservoir computers. When the measured features evolve linearly in the reservoir and the output is formed by linear readout with bias, we show that the capacity available at any fixed delay is limited by what is already present in the preprocessed input. Linear reservoir dynamics can therefore redistribute features, but cannot create new fixed-delay expressive power on their own. This limitation is hidden by global capacity measures, since contributions from different delays can accumulate even when each individual delay is strongly constrained. As an experimentally important realization of this general result, we derive the corresponding Gaussian limit for covariance-based continuous-variable quantum reservoirs. Numerical experiments show that experimentally accessible single-photon operations surpass this limit, establishing them as a genuine resource for quantum reservoir computing. The resulting excess capacity also provides an operational witness of non-Gaussian processing in black-box continuous-variable systems under minimal assumptions.

summaries.en: Linear reservoir computers have a hidden bottleneck where the information capacity at any fixed delay is limited to what is already present in the preprocessed input, but quantum operations like single-photon operations surpass this limit, providing a genuine resource for quantum reservoir computing.
summaries.zh: 线性储层计算机存在一个隐藏的瓶颈，即任何固定时延下的信息容量受限于预处理输入中已有的信息，但像单光子操作这样的量子操作超越了这一限制，为量子储层计算提供了真正的资源。
summaries.ja: 線形リザバーコンピュータには隠れたボトルネックがあり、任意の固定遅延における情報容量は前処理された入力に既に存在するものに限定されるが、単一光子操作などの量子操作はこの限界を超え、量子リザバーコンピューティングの真のリソースを提供する。

title: Permutation Matrix Representation for Quantum Simulation: Comparative Resource Analysis
abstract: We present a comparative study of the permutation matrix representation (PMR) method for Hamiltonian simulation alongside other leading quantum algorithms. Our analysis focuses on resource costs for simulating both time-independent and time-dependent Hamiltonians. For the time-independent case, we benchmark PMR against quantum signal processing (QSP) and qubitization, using the Rydberg interaction Hamiltonian as a representative example. For the time-dependent case, we compare the time-dependent extension of PMR with the quantum highly oscillatory protocol (qHOP), applied to a Floquet-driven transverse field Ising model in arbitrary spatial dimensions. In both regimes, we find that PMR offers complementary advantages in resource requirements and exhibits favorable scaling with certain system parameters, suggesting that it may provide practical benefits on resource-constrained quantum hardware.

summaries.en: This paper compares the permutation matrix representation method with quantum signal processing and qubitization for simulating time-independent and time-dependent Hamiltonians, demonstrating favorable resource scaling with system parameters.
summaries.zh: 本文比较了置换矩阵表示法与量子信号处理及量子化方法在模拟时间无关和时间相关哈密顿量时的资源开销，显示其在系统参数上具有有利的扩展性。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、時間非依存および時間依存ハミルトニアンシミュレーションにおいて、置換行列表現法を量子信号処理や量子化法と比較し、システムパラメータに対して有利なリソーススケーリングを示すことを実証している。

title: Near surface donor-acceptor pairs in hydrogenated homoepitaxial diamond nanolayers
abstract: Hydrogen-terminated diamond is known for its p-type surface conductivity, which arises from a near-surface hole accumulation layer induced by adsorbed acceptor species. Here, we demonstrate that these surface acceptors also form optically active donor-acceptor pairs (DAP) with substitutional nitrogen donors in diamond. The insertion of a nominally undoped CVD interlayer between a nitrogen-rich HPHT substrate and a hydrogen-terminated surface enables the precise tuning of the donor-acceptor separation with nanometer precision. Radiative DAP recombination appears as bright, spectrally narrow lines whose intensity, energy, and decay dynamics depend systematically on interlayer thickness. Individual lines show single-photon statistics, while ensembles exhibit strong polarization anisotropy reflecting the planar donor-acceptor geometry. These findings reveal an optical counterpart of hydrogen-induced surface transfer doping in diamond and establish a surface-defined, nanometer-tunable platform for engineering DAP-based quantum emitters.

summaries.en: Near-surface acceptor species on hydrogenated diamond form optically active donor-acceptor pairs with nitrogen donors, whose separation is precisely tuned via interlayer thickness, producing bright, narrow single-photon lines with polarization anisotropy.
summaries.zh: 氢化金刚石的近表面受主物种与氮供主形成光学活性的供主-受主对，通过中间层厚度精确调控其间距，产生明亮、窄带的单光子线并具有偏振各向异性。
summaries.ja: 水素化ダイヤモンドの表面近傍のアクセプター種は窒素ドナーと光学的に活性なドナー-アクセプターペアを形成し、中間層の厚さによってその間隔をナノメートル精度で調整可能であり、偏光異方性を示す明るく狭い単一光子線を生成する。

title: Performance Analysis of Underwater Quantum Key Distribution Protocols: BB84, SARG04, and BBM92
abstract: Underwater quantum key distribution (UQKD) ensures unconditional communication security based on the fundamental principles of quantum mechanics. This study examines the performance of the BB84, SARG04, and the entanglement-based BBM92 protocols under the impact of both system optical parameters and the physical effects of the underwater channel. The main performance criteria considered are the quantum bit error rate (QBER) and the quantum correlation between the communicating parties as functions of the propagation distance in three types of non-turbulent seawater: clear, coastal, and turbid. For the BBM92 protocol, the quantum channel is modeled using Kraus operators, which characterize the combined effects of attenuation and depolarization on maximally-entangled photons, allowing the derivation of our analytical expression of the QBER, based on the correlation losses between measurements. Monte Carlo simulation results validate the analytical expression of the QBER for all the studied protocols, under various water types, atmospheric conditions, and system parameters. The results determine the conditions under which QKD protocols achieve optimal performance for secure and efficient underwater quantum communications.

summaries.en: This paper analyzes the performance of BB84, SARG04, and BBM92 quantum key distribution protocols in underwater channels, evaluating QBER and quantum correlation as functions of distance in clear, coastal, and turbid seawater.
summaries.zh: 本文分析了BB84、SARG04和BBM92量子密钥分发协议在水下信道中的性能，评估了清晰、沿海和浑浊海水中量子比特错误率和量子相关性随传播距离的变化。
summaries.ja: 本論文では、BB84、SARG04、BBM92の量子鍵配送プロトコルの水中チャネルにおける性能を分析し、清澄、沿岸、濁った海水での伝搬距離に対する量子ビット誤り率と量子相関を評価する。

title: Engineering recoil heating in coherent-scattering levitated optomechanics
abstract: Recoil heating from photon scattering is a fundamental source of decoherence in optical trapping, severely limiting the preparation of nonclassical motional states. In cavity setups in the coherent scattering configuration, a predictive theory of recoil heating rate is missing, as usual perturbative approaches fail in the presence of sharp optical resonances. Hence, current works assume that the recoil heating rate is approximately equal to its free-space value. Here we show that this is not the case, as the electromagnetic environment can strongly modify recoil heating rate by the Purcell effect. Specifically, we predict that this rate can be significantly suppressed in state-of-the-art microcavities, for both center-of-mass and librational motion. To establish these results, we develop a general theoretical framework based on macroscopic quantum electrodynamics and on the few-mode quantization approach developed in nanophotonics. Our method applies to particles trapped in the presence of arbitrary electromagnetic structures, thus providing a route to engineering motional decoherence in levitated optomechanics by photonic structure design.

summaries.en: This work shows that the recoil heating rate in coherent-scattering levitated optomechanics can be significantly modified by the Purcell effect, contrary to the common free-space approximation, and can be suppressed in state-of-the-art microcavities for both center-of-mass and librational motion.
summaries.zh: 这项工作表明，在相干散射悬浮光机械学中，反冲加热速率可以通过Purcell效应被显著改变，这与常见的自由空间近似相反，并且可以在最先进的微腔中同时抑制质心和振动运动的加热。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、コヒーレント散乱浮遊光力学における反跳加熱率が、一般的な自由空間近似に反してパーセル効果によって大幅に変化し、最先端の微小共振器中で重心運動と振動運動の両方について抑制され得ることを示している。

title: Tripartite Interactions Induced Strongly Correlated Quantum Emissions
abstract: Efficient generation of multiquanta emission is crucial for quantum information processing but remains challenging due to its typical reliance on higher-order quantum processes. Here, we theoretically demonstrate strongly correlated photon-phonon emission enabled by direct tripartite interaction. This interaction facilitates the formation of high-order multiquanta states without more intermediate state transitions, thereby avoiding the suppressed transition rates associated with multiple sequential processes and substantially improving resonant transitions. As a result, high-efficiency strongly correlated even-quanta emission (e.g., two photons and two phonons) can be achieved in the presences of dissipation. Beyond that, we show that introducing two-photon dissipation enables strongly correlated odd-quanta emission (e.g., two photons and one phonon) in the tripartite interaction system by parity-protected suppression of single-photon loss and reconstruction of higher-order multiquanta processes. Our work extends multiquanta emission into the tripartite coupling regime and holds promising potential for applications in hybrid quantum networks.

summaries.en: Tripartite interactions enable high-efficiency generation of strongly correlated photon-phonon pairs and parity-protected emission of odd-quanta states in a dissipative quantum system.
summaries.zh: 三方相互作用能够在耗散量子系统中高效产生强关联光子-声子对，并通过宇称保护实现奇数量子态的发射。
summaries.ja: 三体相互作用により、散逸のある量子系で強く相関した光子-フォノン対の高効率生成とパリティ保護された奇数量子状態の放出が可能になる。

title: Bound-state-protected phase metrology for a quantum emitter in a Su-Schrieffer-Heeger bath
abstract: We study local phase estimation for a single quantum emitter coupled to a bosonic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) bath within a microscopic lattice model. Dimerization opens a central gap supporting an in-gap emitter-bath bound state, which suppresses complete relaxation of the emitter coherence. A Dyson-equation analysis yields the local bath Green's function, the in-gap bound-state condition, and the emitter residue controlling the retained phase information. The phase quantum Fisher information links gap formation, detuning, and emitter-bath coupling to the post-transient metrological response. At resonance, stronger coupling enhances transient hybridization but reduces the retained signal by lowering the emitter weight in the bound state. Away from resonance, late-time averages, retention times, and useful interrogation windows track how phase-information protection weakens as the emitter is tuned toward and beyond the band edge. A uniform-chain control shows that the retained signal disappears when the gap closes. In the bulk local-coupling geometry considered here, the response is insensitive to the sign of the dimerization, so the protocol probes spectral-gap physics and bound-state support rather than the SSH winding sector.

summaries.en: We study local phase estimation for a single quantum emitter coupled to a bosonic Su-Schrieffer-Heeger bath, showing that an in-gap bound state protects phase information from complete decoherence and enables metrology.
summaries.zh: 我们研究单个量子发射器与玻色子Su-Schrieffer-Heeger（SSH）浴耦合时的局部相位估计，发现带隙内的束缚态保护相位信息免受完全退相干的影响，从而实现计量学应用。
summaries.ja: 単一の量子エミッターがボゾン性Su-Schrieffer-Heeger浴に結合した局所位相推定を研究し、ギャップ内束縛状態が位相情報を完全なデコヒーレンスから保護し、計測を可能にすることを示す。

title: Indistinguishability of photonic qubits emitted from trapped $^{40}$Ca$^+$ ions via pulsed excitation
abstract: We investigate the indistinguishability of Raman photons generated from two trapped $^{40}$Ca$^+$ ions using few-nanosecond excitation pulses. We elucidate how spontaneous scattering back to the initial state affects Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. We identify the mean number of back-decays as a measurable single-emitter quantity that correlates with achievable interference visibility of photons from two identical emitters.

summaries.en: We investigate how spontaneous scattering back to the initial state affects the indistinguishability of photonic qubits from trapped calcium ions, identifying the mean number of back-decays as a key measurable parameter for predicting interference visibility.
summaries.zh: 我们研究了自发散射回初始态如何影响俘获钙离子光子量子比特的不可区分性，并将平均回退次数确定为预测干涉可见度的关键可测量参数。
summaries.ja: 捕捉されたカルシウムイオンからの光子量子ビットの識別不可能性に及ぼす初期状態への自発散乱の影響を調査し、平均後方崩壊数を干渉可視度を予測する重要な測定可能パラメータとして同定しました。

title: Toward Practical Two-Way Covert Communication
abstract: We study two-way covert communication schemes, where information is transmitted by passively modulating a reflected signal back to the source. We consider optical systems, described by quantum bosonic channels. While broadband classical and quantum light sources offer high covert throughput in theory, the associated mode-matching and phase-synchronization requirements make them impractical. Therefore, we employ a narrowband laser source to experimentally demonstrate a proof-of-concept two-way covert communication system, where the adversary is assumed to be quantum-capable. Furthermore, we propose a correlator-based receiver that attains the broadband gain offered by a quantum light source without the need for precise mode matching.

summaries.en: This paper presents a proof-of-concept two-way covert communication system using a narrowband laser source and a correlator-based receiver that achieves broadband gain without mode-matching.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种使用窄带激光源和基于相关器的接收机的双向隐蔽通信系统概念验证，该系统无需模式匹配即可实现宽带增益。
summaries.ja: 本論文では、狭帯域レーザー光源と相関器ベースの受信機を用いた双方向秘匿通信システムの実証実験を提案し、モードマッチングを必要とせずに広帯域利得を実現する。

title: Dynamical Casimir photons from rotation of a nonspherical particle
abstract: We consider a non-spherical neutral particle spinning in free space and interacting with the electromagnetic quantum vacuum. When the rotation axis is orthogonal to the particle symmetry axis, the scattered field develops frequency sidebands that induce the parametric emission of dynamical Casimir photon pairs. Under the structural constraint of a maximum tip velocity, the emission rate is maximized for a nearly spherical geometry and is further enhanced near a polaritonic resonance. For realistic material parameters, even these optimized upper bounds remain exceedingly small, setting stringent quantitative limits on free-space rotational dynamical Casimir emission with a single nanoparticle.

summaries.en: Rotation of a nonspherical particle in vacuum generates dynamical Casimir photon pairs via parametric emission from scattered field frequency sidebands, but rates are extremely small even under optimized conditions.
summaries.zh: 非球形粒子在真空中旋转通过散射场的频率边带产生参数化发射的动态卡西米尔光子对，但即使在优化条件下，发射率也极小。
summaries.ja: 非球形粒子を真空中で回転させることにより、散乱場の周波数サイドバンドを介したパラメトリック放出によって動的カシミア光子対が生成されるが、最適条件下でもその放出率は極めて小さい。

title: Quantum Networks Using Color Defects in Diamond: Principles, Progress, and Perspectives
abstract: Large-scale quantum networks will enable entirely new applications of quantum information science in fields such as quantum communication, distributed quantum computing, sensing, and metrology. To build nodes of such networks, diamond color defects are one of the promising candidates. Their excellent optical properties, fast spin-qubit control, and long spin coherence times make them well-suited for quantum information processing and quantum memory applications. Additionally, recent advances in the heterogeneous integration of diamond nanophotonic structures with photonic integrated circuits have made these systems more efficient and well-suited for scalable quantum processor architectures. In this comprehensive review, we discuss the optical and spin properties of these systems, recent progress in the building blocks of quantum networks, and demonstrations of metropolitan-scale quantum networks, as well as the challenges associated with these systems at both the fundamental and experimental levels, along with potential solutions.

summaries.en: This review discusses the use of diamond color defects as promising nodes for large-scale quantum networks, highlighting their optical and spin properties, recent progress in quantum network building blocks, and challenges in scaling up these systems.
summaries.zh: 本综述讨论了使用钻石色心作为大规模量子网络节点的前景，重点介绍了它们的光学和自旋特性、量子网络构建模块的最新进展以及扩展这些系统面临的挑战。
summaries.ja: この総説では、大規模量子ネットワークのノードとして有望なダイヤモンド色中心の利用について議論し、その光学特性とスピン特性、量子ネットワーク構築ブロックの最近の進歩、およびこれらのシステムのスケールアップに伴う課題に焦点を当てています。

title: Analytical model for structured light propagation through a turbulent atmosphere
abstract: We develop a straightforward analytical framework for the propagation of spatial light modes through a turbulent atmosphere. Built upon the split-step approach with the mode-based optical field representation, it directly assesses how turbulence-induced phase fluctuations deplete the optical power in the original mode and re-distribute it into neighboring spatial modes. Importantly, this power transfer scales linearly with the propagation distance in a uniform channel, yielding a simple solution for arbitrary distances in the form of a matrix exponential. The transfer rate is determined by the spatial spectral overlap between the turbulence spectrum and the acceptance spectrum for a pair of interacting spatial modes. The model predicts the average power in each spatial mode and is exact when a single mode strongly dominates all others. Our predictions show reasonably good agreement with simulations up to medium-to-strong turbulence levels. The model also confirms the scalings with mode order previously known as empirical observations.

summaries.en: The paper presents an analytical model using matrix exponentials to describe how turbulence linearly transfers power between spatial modes during structured light propagation.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种解析模型，利用矩阵指数描述湍流在结构光传播过程中如何在空间模式之间线性转移功率。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、行列指数を用いて、乱流が構造光伝搬中に空間モード間で電力を線形に転送する様子を記述する解析モデルを提示する。

title: Channel Estimation for Flexible Intelligent Metasurface Aided MIMO Communications
abstract: Flexible Intelligent Metasurfaces (FIMs) enable wireless systems to adapt their three-dimensional geometry through morphing, thereby providing new spatial degrees of freedom. However, continuous deformation complicates the accurate acquisition of Channel State Information (CSI). This work proposes a multidimensional framework for MIMO systems with active FIM arrays at both the transmitter and receiver. A split single-time-scale training protocol sequentially introduces spatial variation by morphing the receiver, then the transmitter. The resulting signal model is formulated as a PARAFAC decomposition, and an alternating least squares (ALS) algorithm is employed to estimate steering matrices and path gains. Our numerical results show that the proposed channel estimation method yields accurate CSI recovery for different system setups.

summaries.en: This paper introduces a channel estimation framework for MIMO systems with active Flexible Intelligent Metasurfaces, using a PARAFAC decomposition and alternating least squares to recover steering matrices and path gains.
summaries.zh: 本文针对配备有源柔性智能超表面的MIMO系统，提出了一种信道估计框架，利用PARAFAC分解和交替最小二乘法来恢复导向矩阵和路径增益。
summaries.ja: 本論文では、アクティブなフレキシブルインテリジェントメタサーフェスを備えたMIMOシステムのためのチャネル推定フレームワークを提案し、PARAFAC分解と交互最小二乗法を用いてステアリング行列とパスゲインを復元する。

title: Absorption and Phase-Contrast Microtomography Using Direct X-ray Detection With COTS CMOS Sensors
abstract: This work presents a high-resolution X-ray microtomography system that uses commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) CMOS image sensors as direct detectors, relying on the sensor s intrinsic resolution to achieve tomographic reconstructions without optical components. The system employs a microfocus X-ray source in cone-beam geometry, enabling both absorption-contrast and propagation-based phase-contrast imaging. A dynamic flat-field correction algorithm mitigates radiation-induced degradation during long acquisitions, helping to overcome limitations of consumer-grade hardware. The setup provides voxel sizes from 3.9 micron to this http URL . Phase contrast visualizes soft tissue boundaries that would be undetectable by conventional radiography. Compared to synchrotron or nanofocus systems, our solution is simpler, lower-cost, and avoids complex optics or slow scans. COTS CMOS sensors appear as a viable alternative for laboratory-scale high-resolution microtomography.
subjects: Image and Video Processing (eess.IV) ; Applied Physics (physics.app-ph)

summaries.en: This work presents a high-resolution X-ray microtomography system using COTS CMOS sensors as direct detectors, achieving absorption and phase-contrast imaging with a simple and low-cost setup.
summaries.zh: 这项工作提出了一种高分辨率X射线显微断层成像系统，使用商用现成CMOS传感器作为直接探测器，通过简单且低成本的设置实现了吸收和相位对比成像。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、市販のCMOSセンサーを直接検出器として使用した高分解能X線マイクロトモグラフィーシステムを提示し、シンプルで低コストな構成で吸収と位相コントラストイメージングを実現する。
